fusions.name: Gliding Hatchet
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 4 damage and hits harder the further it glides, up to 2 times its damage at 8 tiles.

fusions.name: Downdraft Cleave
fusions.desc: A swing that drives wind 4 tiles ahead in a cone, dealing 12 wind damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thermal Lift
fusions.desc: Carries you 2 tiles forward and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Hunting Stoop
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
